newsitem.title: UK: On Demand Info to announce new product soon.
newsitem.headline: On Demand Info to announce new product soon.

text.p: On Demand Information Plc said on Wenesday that it was in the final stages of a "significant product development", which related to high quality networked multimedia with fast delivery over the Internet. In a brief statement following a sharp rise in its share price, the company said it would make a full announcement at the end of September or in early October, with product demonstrations starting in October.
The stock closed at 135.5 pence, a rise of 23 pence.
